title: Hauntboard
summary: Public Ootle message-board source with browser-held wallet keys. On October 14, 2026, two browser loads reported “Network unavailable” and failed configuration checks; reading and posting were unavailable in that session. The prior October 13 public-reader success remains historical evidence. Posts are public and permanent; testnet resets may remove history. Current documentation points users to the separate TariTracker faucet and includes local-client instructions. No wallet or transaction action was performed.
